description.en:
CODROID 02 is ESTUN CODROID’s second-generation industrial humanoid, listed here under parent company Estun Automation. It combines internally developed rigid and quasi-direct-drive joints with separate high-level decision and motion-control systems. The published specification gives 170 cm height, 70 kg weight excluding the battery, and 5 kg payload per arm excluding the dexterous hand.

The body is offered with 29 or 31 degrees of freedom depending on the waist configuration; hand degrees of freedom are specified separately. ESTUN CODROID describes material handling, component picking, inspection, visual teaching and coordinated robot work as intended applications.
